haewonmek--siege-of-daeya.scene: INTRODUCING HAEWONMEK, Kangrim's partner on the reaper roads: he doesn't ask a question, he asks for last words. Night, the inner room of the burning fortress of Daeya, time stopped: smoke hangs motionless and embers float frozen in the air. Low worm's-eye three-quarter angle from the floorboards: tall and broad in his black reaper's robe over the blue sash and coral-red layers, the wide black gat brim hiding his eyes entirely, only the hard mouth and jaw visible, the whole tall gat well inside the frame. He looks down at someone kneeling just out of frame, a red-covered register open in one hand, the other resting on the hilt of a long black iron blade held low. Grave, a little impatient, about to say 'Any last words?'. Firelight from the burning yard through the paper lattice rakes across his jaw and robe from the side in orange; cold plum-grey #6b5b6e in the shadows; the edges of his robe dissolve into ink-brush strokes. The pages show no legible writing.
